meaning_en: to caulk ship seams with oakum and tallow

past.de: Der Schiffbauer kalfaterte die Planken des Schiffes
past.en: The shipwright caulked the ship planks

present.de: Er kalfatert die Nähte mit geöltem Werg
present.en: He caulks the seams with oiled coir fibers

imperative.en: Caulk tightly against every water leak!
